item.title: Evidence labels
item.description:
Label Use when Standing list
Well-supported Peer-reviewed paper, official regulator text, confirmed commercial order —
Preliminary Preprint, company lab data, pilot/small-cell results —
Unverified / Unsourced Assertion without solid primary source [[logs/unsourced]] (subsection of [[logs/conspiracies]])
Fringe Conspiracy-style narratives; document only [[logs/conspiracies]]

Unsourced is not automatically Fringe. A missing citation is a source problem. A cover-up story is a narrative problem. They can attach to the same sentence; the labels stay separate.

item.title: Glossary
item.description:
Parent: [[guides/index|Look up]]. Labels: [[guides/evidence-labels]]. ISO wording: [[reference/iso-vocabulary]].

How to read an entry: headword; what it is; see also near-terms; here for the page that uses it.

A

ABC trilayer n. Three graphene sheets stacked rhombohedrally (A-B-C). Not magic-angle bilayer. See also MATBG; moiré. Here [[timeline/2019]].

AIM n. London Stock Exchange junior market. See also ASX; NEEQ; TSX. Here [[topics/finance/listings]].

anomalous Hall crystal n. Electronic crystal with a topological Hall response; 2025 twisted-stack report. See also moiré. Here [[timeline/2025]].

item.title: How we use other sites
item.description:
This archive is not a newsletter, not a handbook shop, and not a competitor to trade portals. It is a labeled public shelf.

Graphene-Info and cousins

Graphene-Info (Metalgrass, since 2009) is the widest public radar for company names, SKU talk, and “this week” releases. OLED-Info and the rest of that network work the same way.

Allowed

  • A name we did not have (plant, product mark, listing).
  • A date that points at an ASX / AIM / SEDAR / Companies House / company PDF.
  • A company-stated tonne or m² figure, logged as company-stated or Preliminary, with the year of the copy.

Not allowed

item.title: Posting calendar
item.description:
Locked house rule for @GrapheneFacts. Timezone: America/New_York.

Day Theme What
Mon Historical On this day / this week in graphene — [[timeline/index]]
Tue Applications Medical, biomechanical, sensors, other uses
Wed Finance Companies, plants, orders, listings, investments, awards
Thu Paper / engineering One result or process
Fri Fringe Documented claim + Fringe label
Sat Accomplishments Order, plant, award, durable lab result
Sun Weekly wrap Thread + [[weekly/2026-W38

Quiet is allowed. Recycled claims go in [[recurrence/log]], not as “new.”
